finalText:
ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

I read this as a research ask: compare the two parsers in the fixture and write a short markdown report. I'll stop when the report file exists and its claims match what I read in the parser sources.

toolArgs.name: eval
toolArgs.args: {"language":"js","summary":"Locate the fixture and parser files in the working directory","code":"const r = await Bun.$`pwd; git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>&1; ls -la; find . -ipath '*fixture*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | head -50; ls ~/.omo 2>/dev/null | head`.nothrow().text();\nprint(r);"}

toolArgs.name: eval
toolArgs.args: {"code":"const r = await Bun.$`find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50; echo ---; cat Cargo.toml slow.sh; echo ---; git log --oneline | head; ls -la .omo .omo/*; wc -l src/*`.nothrow().text();\nprint(r);","language":"js","summary":"List fixture files and sizes"}

toolArgs.name: eval
toolArgs.args: {"code":"print(await Bun.$`cd src; for f in lib.rs parser_a.rs parser_b.rs cli.rs; do echo \"=== $f\"; cat -n $f; done; which cargo rustc`.nothrow().text());","language":"js","summary":"Read both parser sources and their callers"}

toolArgs.name: eval
toolArgs.args: {"code":"for (const f of ['lib','parser_a','parser_b','cli']) print('=== '+f+'\\n'+(await Bun.file('src/'+f+'.rs').text()).split('\\n').map((l,i)=>`${i+1}: ${l}`).join('\\n'));","language":"js","summary":"Read parser sources with line numbers"}

toolArgs.name: create_goal
toolArgs.args: {"objective":"LIGHT tier. Deliver parser-comparison.md (short markdown report) in the fixture repo root comparing src/parser_a.rs (RecursiveDescentParser) and src/parser_b.rs (ShiftReduceParser), with every behavioral claim backed by file:line or an executed scratch probe. Criteria: (1) each claim in the report cites file:line or a probe result; (2) the riskiest claims (B's associativity, trailing input handling in A, overflow handling in B) are proven by running a scratch cargo test in a temp copy, with output captured. Scratch dir removed afterward. I'll stop right away when parser-comparison.md exists, its probe-backed claims match captured output, and the scratch dir is deleted."}

toolArgs.name: eval
eval
